content.title: GameStop earnings, JOLTS labor data: What to Watch
content.description:
Asking for a Trend host Josh Lipton takes a look at the top stories for investors to watch on Tuesday, Dec. 9.

AutoZone (AZO) and Campbell's (CPB) report earnings in the morning, while Casey's General Stores (CASY), AeroVironment (AVAV), GameStop (GME), and Cracker Barrel (CBRL) report in the afternoon.

The Small Business Administration's (SBA's) National Federation of Independent Business (NFIB) Small Business Optimism Index for the month of November will be published in the morning. Economists expect a reading of 98.3, a slight uptick from the previous month's 98.2.

The US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) will release the delayed results for October's Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey (JOLTS) in the morning. Economists expect the number to hold steady from the previous month at 7.2 million.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Asking for a Trend.

content.title: Fed's rate decision, Oracle & Broadcom earnings: What to Watch
content.description:
Market Domination Overtime host Josh Lipton takes a look at the top stories for investors to watch next week, starting Monday, Dec. 8.

Another wave of earnings is on tap: Toll Brothers (TOL) on Monday, Campbell's (CPB) and Cracker Barrel (CBRL) on Tuesday, Oracle (ORCL) and Adobe (ADBE) on Wednesday, Broadcom (AVGO) and Costco (COST) on Thursday, and Rent the Runway (RENT) on Friday, among others.

The Small Business Association's (SBA's) National Federation of Independent Business (NFIB) will release its monthly Small Business Optimism Index.

The Federal Reserve's December meeting will kick off on Tuesday, while the FOMC's decision on interest rates will be announced on Wednesday.

Tune in to Yahoo Finance on Wednesday, Dec. 10 at 2:00 p.m. for live coverage of Fed Chair Jerome Powell's post-decision press conference.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination Overtime.
